links.outcome: LLM classification performance across patient age, sex, and insurance subgroups
links.effect: No model bias found in relation to patient age, sex, or insurance; overall sensitivity 87.2%, AUC 0.93/0.92 on holdout/deployment sets.
links.quote: Analyses revealed no model bias in relation to patient age, sex, or insurance.

screen.reason: Evaluates the accuracy of an open-source LLM (LLaMA) to retrospectively extract documentation of ADHD medication side effect monitoring from EHR notes for quality-of-care audit, without testing a specific deployment practice or guardrail.
